reason: After reviewing the entire Dollar General Corporation 10-K filing for fiscal year ended January 30, 2026, no Total Addressable Market (TAM) disclosure was found. The company describes its business model, competitive position, store count, merchandise categories, and customer base, but does not provide any specific TAM figures, market size estimates, or serviceable addressable market data. The filing contains no company-disclosed market opportunity quantifications in dollar terms or other measurable units.
